tagline: An iPhone music player for your own collection.
alt_hero: erhu Home and Now Playing on an iPhone
beta_intro: The third beta is available as an unsigned IPA for iOS 17 and newer, installed with your own Apple ID through a sideloading tool. Compatibility with other iPhones and iOS versions is still being tested.
static_desc: The full app with still album covers
animated_desc: Everything above, plus downloaded animated album covers in the app and on the Lock Screen
install: Install the IPA with [SideStore](https://sidestore.io/) or [AltStore Classic](https://altstore.io/), then add music with **+**, the Files app or **Wi-Fi Transfer**. erhu plays music stored on your iPhone; radio stations and smart playlists select tracks from your own library.
refresh: With a free Apple ID, refresh the app within **7 days**; the usual limit of **3 active apps** includes your installer. Installing a newer IPA over the existing app keeps your library, settings, favourites and listening history. See the [installation guide](docs/INSTALLING.md).
feature_1: Albums, artists, playlists, favourites, listening history and listening stats.
feature_2: Smart playlists and radio stations generated from your library.
feature_3: Songs filtered by genre and mood: Chill, High energy, Late night, Feel-good, Party, Love songs, Sad & reflective, Dark, Focus and Throwback.
feature_4: On-device VYBE search by mood, artist or song, built into the app.
feature_5: Synced lyrics from embedded lyrics, LRC files, cached results and LRCLIB, with offline downloads.
feature_6: Queue management, A–B loops, bookmarks, Auto Fix Tags with review and Revert, and online or local artwork.
feature_7: Higher-resolution cover and artist-photo upgrades, checked against your current image before saving.
feature_8: Transition Studio with album, playlist and track-pair crossfades and editable curves.
feature_9: 8-band equalizer with presets, and a visualizer.
feature_10: Artwork-coloured themes, light, dark and system appearance, and imported theme packages.
feature_11: Swipeable cover carousel in Now Playing and a floating glass mini-player.
feature_12: Animated album covers in the app and on the Lock Screen (animated-artwork build only).
feature_13: Wi-Fi Transfer from a computer's browser, and manual and automatic update checks for new releases.
formats: MP3, AAC, ALAC, FLAC, WAV, AIFF, CAF and Ogg Vorbis/Opus are supported, in M4A, M4B and MP4 containers where applicable. Protected (DRM) files are not.
shots_intro: Captured on an iPhone from the current build. They show the real interfaces.
album_order: [Album order and transitions](docs/ALBUM_ORDER_AND_TRANSITIONS.md) · The in-app introduction covers these tools; reopen it from **Settings → About Erhu → Introduction**.
animated_note: Animated covers are in the animated-artwork build only. The Lock Screen needs iOS 26 or newer, and iOS decides when it shows the animation.
vybe_1: VYBE searches your library using descriptions of what you want to hear, such as a mood, an artist or a song you like. It runs entirely on your iPhone; nothing is uploaded and there is no cloud inference.
vybe_2: On iOS, VYBE's model is built into the app (a compressed Core ML MiniLM, about 17 MB), so there is nothing to download. Turn it on during the introduction or in Settings, then leave the app open while it indexes your library. See [VYBE details](docs/VYBE.md).
build_1: erhu for iOS uses Swift, SwiftUI, AVFoundation and Core Audio.
build_mac: On a Mac with Xcode and [XcodeGen](https://github.com/yonaskolb/XcodeGen):
build_ci: The [iOS workflow](.github/workflows/ios.yml) builds an unsigned IPA and runs the native interaction checks and unit tests on a simulator for both artwork branches. See [Build from source](docs/BUILDING.md).
build_branches: `without-animated-art` is the default branch and builds the static-artwork variant; `with-animated-art` builds the animated variant. Shared changes are kept in sync on both.
feedback: Report bugs through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/MeezaUni/Erhu-iOS/issues). Include your iPhone model, iOS version, app version, artwork variant and steps to reproduce the problem.
support: erhu is free, with no ads or accounts. If you'd like to help cover the Apple Developer fee so it can go on the App Store, you can [buy me a coffee on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/erhu). The same link is in the app under **Settings → About Erhu**.
